g.text: Both systems miss real time under heavy destruction
Separate workloads, hardware and timer scopes. Different vertical scales. No cross-engine speed ratio.
Vibe: live server, 32-iteration budget, freeze on. Native: headless accepted physics, convergence required, ordinary sleep.
